messages.subject: Re: [knitr] floating figures
parts:
Since you used the H option, I doubt if you had \usepackage{float} in
your preamble. Anyway, I cannot reproduce your problem with this
minimal example:

\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{float}
\begin{document}

Hello world.

\begin{figure}[H]
<<>>=
plot(1)
@
\caption{Do not float!}
\end{figure}

Hello world.

\end{document}

Regards,
Yihui

On Mon, Sep 24, 2012 at 12:44 PM, msharp <rmsh...@gmail.com> wrote:
> I am moving from Sweave to knitr and am missing something very basic about
> figure placement. If I simple create a plot knitr places it at the point I
> create it in the create PDF. If I place \begin{figure} and \end{figure}
> around it (so that I can add captions) it get printed at the end of the
> document even if I use fig.show = 'asis' or \begin{figure}[H].

code chunks, so that you will know if the problem comes from LaTeX or
knitr.
